stops.note: 'sandy harbour', a Kent port that became one of the Cinque Ports supplying ships to the crown

named after John Montagu, 4th Earl of Sandwich; Edward Gibbon's journal for 24 November 1762 records gentlemen at a London club eating 'a bit of cold meat, or a Sandwich', while the story that the earl ate them at the gambling table comes from a 1765 French travel book and may be gossip

current_meaning: two pieces of bread with a filling between them
